purpose: Verify selected AC1024 inline modeler text carrier and entity-family fields through generated ASCII/Binary DXF readback into a headless consumer.
changes: Added runtime-generated 3DSOLID, REGION and BODY records with distinct layers and two group-1 text chunks per carrier.
Checked entity type, raw byte count, chunk codes/order/offsets/lengths, separation from DWG inline ACIS and DataStorage fields, and exact preserved carrier digest for each entity.
Repeated callback readback with ext=false and ext=true for both ASCII and Binary DXF.

Used AC1024 because its inline SAT text route matches this generated carrier. AC1027 is intentionally excluded because it uses the separate R2013+ ACDSDATA/SAB route and refuses this raw inline-text profile.
scopeLimit: Carrier and callback transport only. Synthetic strings are not valid ACIS geometry; this does not verify ACIS parsing, SAB/ACDSDATA association, B-rep semantics, independent interoperability, or native consumer behavior.
fixturePolicy: Drawing files are generated under a temporary directory and removed. No drawing fixture was added.
